answer: Locks are written down in thread, expire in island, and opal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 31 aliases therefore needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4068 identities would post 3008 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
